meta.title: 24513 Walnut Street | Offering Memorandum
meta.description: A three-unit residential investment opportunity in Old Town Newhall, California.

property.zoning: Old Town Newhall Specific Plan — Corridor (COR)
property.parking: Garage and on-site parking; buyer to verify count and configuration

expenses.label: Property taxes
expenses.basis: Estimated reassessment at 1.403% of offering price

expenses.label: Water / sewer
expenses.basis: Broker estimate; responsibility to be verified

expenses.label: Trash
expenses.basis: Broker estimate; responsibility to be verified

sale_comps.occupancy: Two units occupied; the 1,500 SF townhome was offered vacant.
sale_comps.condition: Fully renovated 1954 core, newer detached ADU, new electrical panel, in-unit laundry, pool and spa.
sale_comps.note: The closest Newhall sale and the finished version of this product. Its $1.15M result is a ceiling-side anchor, not a direct condition match.
strengths: Same city, zip and three-unit scale
Renovated units plus newly built ADU
cautions: Parking and exact zoning were not fully documented
sale_comps.image_alt: Front residence at the sold triplex at 25252 Atwood Boulevard

sale_comps.occupancy: All three large family units were occupied at below-market rents.
sale_comps.condition: One unit renovated; copper repipe, tankless water heater, in-unit laundry and ten parking spaces.
sale_comps.note: The best regulatory match. Its larger two-bath units and stronger improvements offset Walnut's larger lot, better location and ADU optionality.
cautions: Only one of three units was renovated
Per-unit comparison is distorted by much larger units
sale_comps.image_alt: Exterior of the sold triplex at 1237 Coronel Street

sale_comps.occupancy: Fully occupied with stable tenants and materially suppressed rents.
sale_comps.condition: Pride-of-ownership exterior with new roofs on both buildings; interiors were not shown before offer acceptance.
sale_comps.note: A fast, competitive sale with nearly identical three-unit scale. Walnut trades better location, regulation and land for Oro Vista's stronger presentation.
cautions: LA City RSO restricts rent recovery
Seller concessions were reported but not quantified
sale_comps.image_alt: Exterior of the sold triplex at 10427 Oro Vista Avenue

sale_comps.occupancy: All three detached homes were occupied at rents equal to 43% of the listing's projected market level.
sale_comps.condition: Original-condition detached cottages with floor or wall heat, no air conditioning, separate utility meters and a two-car garage.
sale_comps.note: The closest physical analog: three detached vintage homes on a large flat lot. Its sale arc shows buyers priced the real estate and future rent recovery, not current yield.
strengths: Large flat lot and eight parking spaces
cautions: LA City RSO and extreme rent suppression
Original systems and no air conditioning
sale_comps.image_alt: Aerial view of the three-home property sold at 10030 Pinewood Avenue

sale_comps.occupancy: Four occupied dwellings with post-renovation rents near market; one studio was non-conforming.
sale_comps.condition: Approximately $300,000 of reported improvements, including kitchens, baths, balconies and upgraded electrical panels.
sale_comps.note: Useful floor evidence, but not a clean triplex comparison. Canyon location, fire exposure, county rent controls and the non-conforming fourth unit weigh on the print.
cautions: Four actual units but only three legal
Canyon access, fire exposure and RSTPO regulation
sale_comps.image_alt: Hillside exterior of the sold income property at 11344 Santol Drive

sale_comps.occupancy: Delivered completely vacant; income metrics use projected rents rather than achieved leases.
sale_comps.condition: Original-condition fixer with no listed heating, cooling or laundry and three separate water meters.
sale_comps.note: The ring's floor sale. Its tiny building inflates price per square foot, so the useful evidence is absolute price and price per unit—not the $487/SF headline.
strengths: Vacant delivery and fast nine-day sale
Clean standard sale with no concessions
cautions: Worst physical condition in the set
sale_comps.image_alt: Exterior of the sold fixer triplex at 216 Harding Avenue

rent_evidence.note: Selected near the lower quartile for the detached rear house; condition and lease terms require verification.
Selected below the lower quartile to reflect vintage and current condition.
Achieved rents of $2,175 to $3,450 support the direction of the pro forma but reflect superior condition.
